ruling.explanation:
Both parties largely agree on the facts, and the disagreement is about the remedy. The following is addressed to the rider and the driver together.

THE DEVIATION. EV-GPS-02833 is complete and unimpaired for policy purposes: 182 fixes at a 10-second sampling interval against a 10-second expected interval, 100% coverage, an empty gaps array and max_gap_sec of 0.0. None of the POL-RD-07(a)–(c) limbs fires, so no independent corroboration is required and no escalation arises on that ground; the trace decides the deviation on its own. Its trace_distance_km is 23.22 km against the booking-time optimal of 18.4 km carried on EV-TRIP-02833. The excess is 4.82 km, or 26.20% of optimal, which passes both POL-RD-01 limbs (greater than 0.8 km and greater than 20%). Per POL-RD-01 the trace figure governs and the rounded trip_record copy of 23.2 km was not used for the threshold test. The deviation is ESTABLISHED but NOT MATERIAL: 26.20% is below the 50% figure and 4.82 km is below the 8.0 km figure, so POL-RD-06 is not engaged on this trip, its FULL_REFUND uplift is unavailable, and no driver-conduct referral is produced. The driver_profile was consulted anyway: deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 260 completed trips in 90 days, so no pattern exists under either limb of POL-RD-06.

THE DRIVER'S TRAFFIC EXCUSE. The driver's statement 'Traffic.' cites no evidence id. The only advisory artifact in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-02833-01, is MISSING, its issue code is MISSING_ARTIFACT and its weight_multiplier is 0.0, so it can carry no fact and POL-RD-03 cannot be run on this record. Under POL-RD-13 the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08: it neither reduces the measured excess nor supplies an amended optimal route, and the computation runs against the booked optimal of 18.4 km and 24.8 minutes. Because the driver names no advisory identifier, the missing advisory is not a POL-RD-10(5) trigger and the case does not escalate on that ground. No other exculpatory clause is available: EV-CHAT-02833 is complete with zero messages, so POL-RD-04 has no rider instruction to test and no waypoint_hint to corroborate; no pickup or dropoff amendment is recorded (amended_optimal_distance_km is null), so POL-RD-05 cannot run; the fare model is METERED, so POL-RD-11 does not apply; and the vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply.

THE REFUND. Under POL-RD-02 on the METERED fare: recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 × 18.4 km = 13.80 distance + 0.28 × 24.8 min = 6.944 time) × the surge multiplier of 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier on EV-FARE-02833, plus 0.80 platform fee, plus 0.00 ERP/tolls, plus 0.00 waiting time, less 0.00 promo discount = SGD 25.344. Refund = charged_total 30.46 − 25.344 = SGD 5.116, rounded UP to the nearest SGD 0.05 = SGD 5.15. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and is 16.8% of charged_total, well short of the 90% that would substitute a FULL_REFUND. The rider's request for a full refund of the trip (SGD 7.50) is not supported by the arithmetic. The rider's pleaded ground — 'this driver has six deviation flags' — rests on driver_profile.prior_deviation_flags, a lifetime counter that POL-GEN-01 marks context only and that POL-RD-06 does not use; the trailing-window counter it does use is 0. That ground was discarded and cannot carry the claim; the rider's entitlement rests on this trip's own trace and on the POL-RD-02 arithmetic, as the rider's own submission accepts.

PASS-THROUGH LINES. EV-FARE-02833 carries no ERP or toll lines (erp_gantries empty, ERP total SGD 0.00), no airport surcharge (the trip ENDS at Ang Mo Kio and does not originate at an airport), no waiting-time fee and no promo discount. There is therefore nothing to add on top of the POL-RD-02 figure, and POL-RD-09(1)'s anti-double-count rule is satisfied. No billing-integrity referral arises, and no driver compensation is due: the billed distance of 23.2 km against the traced 23.22 km is a shortfall of 0.02 km, far below the 1.0 km that POL-RD-04's compensation limb requires.

CONFIDENCE AND ESCALATION. Every fact the ruling rests on — the excess and its percentage, the optimal distance and duration, and the fare arithmetic — is carried by artifacts at weight_multiplier 1.0 (EV-GPS-02833, EV-TRIP-02833, EV-FARE-02833), so confidence is not capped and the MISSING advisory, which carries no deciding fact, does not lower it. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires: the trip identifiers match across all three artifacts, the timestamps are consistent and run forward, the trace is not impaired, no cited artifact is missing in support of an invoked exculpatory clause, the refund is far below SGD 150.00 and below charged_total, and no fare line lacks a counterpart. The rider receives a partial refund of SGD 5.15; the balance of SGD 25.31 of the fare stands and no compensation is payable to the driver. Because the monetary effect of SGD 5.15 does not exceed the SGD 8.00 execution threshold in POL-GEN-05, the refund may be executed automatically, subject to the appeal route under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
